race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes Hcp
race.comment: GOLDEN STRAAND (4) earns top billing off a smart Randwick win when resuming last month, and the form around her last prep makes for favourable reading. Has been kept fresh with a month between runs, a tickover trial though keeps him up to the mark. Is unbeaten in three at 1200m and is perfectly placed to keep that record in tact. POCKET FULL (10) is an intriguing runner resuming from a short break for the Kendrick's. He's proven a tough one to catch for punters but boasts peaks that are right up to this, especially under the featherweight he gets in at. Can cause an upset. MILLANE (9) also gets in light and if he can reproduce what he did at Eagle Farm two back, he too can cause a scare to the hot-pot. EPIC PROPORTIONS (3) has mixed his form since heading north but shoulders the peaks to be competitive. Youngberry's claim gets him in well and he's worth some thought. RESTONICA (6) was good in the Weetwood first-up and is unbeaten at Doomben. Have to respect.
